text:
Alex: Heads-up — planned rollforward tonight at 22:00 UTC. Need one more signoff on the hotfix before we cut prod traffic. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/8912 — this reverts a small KV-cache regression. Cutover window 22:00–22:20 UTC. If you can give final signoff please either approve on the PR or comment `+signoff` here. tagging @Mira @Jamal @Priya

Mira: I can be on-call at 22:00. What's the smoke checklist so I know what to verify?

Alex: smoke checklist: 1) canary pod ready 2) `/health` -> 200 from 3 hosts 3) simple generate (<=100ms median) 4) no redis/kvs errors in logs. I'll paste quick commands.

Alex: ```
# quick smoke commands
curl -fsS https://canary.example.internal/health
for h in host1 host2 host3; do curl -fsS https://$h/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'; done
journalctl -u inference | tail -n 200 | grep -i "redis"
```

Jamal: I'm jumping into the PR now. FYI saw a flaky e2e yesterday (timeout on long-runner) — not sure it's related but worth noting. @release-bot can you rerun e2e for #8912?

release-bot: CI status for PR #8912: build ✅, unit tests ✅, e2e flaky — 1/3 runs failed (timeout on long-runner). No security alerts.

Priya: skimmed the diff, looks safe. I won't block. I prefer canary+30m watch rather than immediate full roll. Will approve once e2e is green or after we decide canary approach. :thumbsup:

Mira: good plan. I'll run the smoke steps after canary goes up. If Jamal gives a quick OK on the code, I'm comfortable signing off.

Jamal: quick review done — small nit on a log message, not blocking. LGTM.

Alex: thanks Jamal — that's one signoff. @Priya can you drop the second signoff for canary+30m watch? Otherwise need another approver before cutoff.

Priya: giving second signoff for canary + 30m watch. Approving PR now. :white_check_mark:

Mira: noted. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results. @release-bot please schedule canary at 22:00 with `deploy canary pr/8912`.

release-bot: scheduled: canary deploy for PR #8912 at 22:00 UTC. I will post rollout progress and health checks to this thread.

Alex: runbook deploy command for owners: 
```
./deploy.sh --env prod --canary pr/8912 --timeout 1200
# rollback
./deploy.sh --rollback pr/8912
```

Mira: ack. I'll post "smoke done" with results within 5 minutes of deploy.

Jamal: thanks all — I'll monitor perf traces and errors. Ping me if tail latency spikes.

Priya: approved on GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/8912/commits. Good luck :rocket:

Alex: closing loop — PR approved and canary scheduled. I'm the rollout owner. Thanks everyone!
